page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for accelerated graphics or hardware-dependent machine learning workloads. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 4 Gbps, and the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfr8i.xlarge offers a memory-optimized resource density. This profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring moderate compute power paired with a larger memory footprint, avoiding the need to provision higher vCPU tiers just to obtain sufficient RAM. Appropriate workloads include memory-intensive applications, small-to-medium databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications.
